summary: Scrolling and panning interactions were improved, particularly for Metal ANGLE (Apple's OpenGL compatibility layer) to better synchronize with video compositing, and native scrolling in regular scroll boxes now works more smoothly. Double-tap zoom behavior was refined to be more predictable, and **HDR video playback now properly handles extended dynamic range content** when available. Various test fixes addressed compatibility with the newer Nova sidebar design and resolved edge cases in autoscrolling and viewport handling.
